This analysis examines water quality at 10 streams sampled monthly from January to December 2023.

We measured:

-   pH

-   Dissolved oxygen (mg/L)

-   Nitrate concentrations (mg/L0)

Our goal is to identify sites exceeding EPA standards.

```{r}

#Load data
water <- read.csv("../data/raw/water_samples.csv")

#Quick look

head(water)
```

## Summary statistics

```{r}

mean_ph <- mean(water$ph, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_temp <- mean(water$temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)

```

The mean pH across all sites was `r round(mean_ph, 2)`.

The mean pH across all sites was 'r (round mean_ph 2)'.
